_about: Trips led before HQ's own records (history.json starts in 2023), added Oct 19 2026 for current team members only. build-leaders.py merges these into the trip history at build time. Sources: Podio trip records 2015-2017 (Dropbox, only people the record shows on the trip: in a leader list with a flight, room or staff line; 'in charge' alone does not count), the HQ 2020, 2021 and 2022 tabs (ALL STAFF column, trips that ran), GHL trip tags (they tag guests too, so on their own they only count for Mantas, the founder), and lists sent by leaders. No guest data and no traveler numbers. date: month or year when the exact days are not known, none when there is no date at all. To fix a trip, edit it here.
